arguments.decision_needed: The tenant reports the landlord's LG washing machine (there when they moved in) has failed with a power fault and says it can't be fixed (their own web research, not confirmed by an engineer). They offer to buy a replacement themselves, which would remain their property and be taken with them when they leave. Please tell us: (1) do you consent to the tenant installing their own machine; (2) what should happen to the existing LG (inspect/repair, dispose, or keep); (3) who pays to disconnect and remove the old machine and fit the new one; or (4) whether you would rather we send our contractor to inspect/repair it, or arrange your own.
options: Consent to tenant's own machine; state who pays for removal of the old one and fitting, and what happens to the old LG
Our contractor inspects the LG first and quotes repair or replacement
You arrange your own contractor or replacement

arguments.body: Thanks for letting us know about the washing machine. Fitting your own machine needs the landlord's consent, so we've put your offer to them, including that it would stay yours and go with you if you move. We've also asked what should happen to the current LG and who covers removing it and fitting the new one. Please don't disconnect or remove the old machine until we confirm. If you can, send a photo of the machine and any error code. We'll update you by 2025-07-30 at the latest.

arguments.decision_needed: The tenant reports the landlord's LG washing machine (there when they moved in) has failed with a power fault and says it can't be fixed (their own web research, not confirmed by an engineer). They offer to buy a replacement themselves, which would remain their property and be taken with them when they leave. Please tell us: (1) do you consent to the tenant installing their own machine; (2) what should happen to the existing LG (inspect/repair, dispose, or keep); (3) who pays to disconnect and remove the old machine and fit the new one; or (4) whether you would rather we send our contractor to inspect/repair it, or arrange your own.
options: Consent to tenant's own machine; state who pays for removal of the old one and fitting, and what happens to the old LG
Our contractor inspects the LG first and quotes repair or replacement
You arrange your own contractor or replacement

arguments.body: Thanks for letting us know about the washing machine. Fitting your own machine needs the landlord's consent, so we've put your offer to them, including that it would stay yours and go with you if you move. We've also asked what should happen to the current LG and who covers removing it and fitting the new one. Please don't disconnect or remove the old machine until we confirm. If you can, send a photo of the machine and any error code. We'll update you by 2025-07-30 at the latest.

arguments.note: Tenant wants to replace landlord's LG washer with own machine. Not a repair; needs landlord consent. Tenant's machine stays theirs, not on inventory, removed when they leave. Landlord asked about old LG and who pays removal/fitting. Fault diagnosis is tenant's own, unconfirmed.
